Book 1 teaching cohort (simulated)

Source: R/data.R
growdat.Rd

A simulated school health cohort of about 3,500 children followed through annual examinations from 2018 to 2025 (no examinations in 2021) at three sites, ages 18 months to 18 years. Generated by wgh_simulate(4000, preset = "wgh_like", seed = 2024). The cohort resembles the school health cohort of the research program so analyses give tables and figures similar to the papers. It is not real data.

Usage

growdat

Format

A data frame with one row per visit:

pid

Child identifier

sex

Factor, Male or Female

site

Site (Site1, Site2, Site3)

dob, examdate

Date of birth and of examination

yearvisit

School year of the examination

age

Exact age in years

height, weight, bmi

cm, kg, kg/m2

haz, waz, baz

WHO z-scores (weight-for-age only to 10 years)

Source

Simulated with wgh_simulate(). See data-raw/datasets.R.

Examples

head(growdat)
#>       pid    sex  site        dob yearvisit   examdate   age height weight
#> 1 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2019 2019-10-25 3.001   95.0   16.0
#> 2 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2020 2020-09-18 3.901  103.1   18.5
#> 3 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2022 2022-12-10 6.127  116.9   23.5
#> 4 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2023 2023-11-29 7.097  122.8   26.1
#> 5 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2024 2024-11-26 8.090  128.6   28.2
#> 6 C000001 Female Site2 2016-10-24      2025 2025-10-24 8.999  134.3   32.5
#>     bmi    haz   waz   baz
#> 1 17.73 -0.015 1.091 1.588
#> 2 17.40  0.252 1.091 1.387
#> 3 17.20  0.202 0.902 1.079
#> 4 17.31  0.262 0.885 0.993
#> 5 17.05  0.260 0.650 0.681
#> 6 18.02  0.296 0.812 0.880
table(growdat$sex, growdat$site)
#>         
#>          Site1 Site2 Site3
#>   Male    2869  1237   519
#>   Female  2568  1062   408
# Wrap in the data contract, computing age from the two dates
gd <- wgh_data(growdat, id = "pid", sex = "sex", dob = "dob", date = "examdate",
               height = "height", weight = "weight", site = "site")
gd
#> <wgh_data>: 8663 visits from 3259 children
#> Ages 1.5 to 18.49 years. Sex: Male 4625, Female 4038
#> Sites: Site1, Site2, Site3
#> Years: 2018 to 2026
#> Mapping: id = pid, sex = sex, dob = dob, date = examdate, height = height,
#> weight = weight, site = site
